notes.title: Windows 8 and Ctrl+Alt+Arrow keys
notes.content:
Hi Everybody!

This game uses Ctrl and Alt keys by default, and it's come to our attention that Ctrl+Alt+arrow keys actually rotate the entire screen on Windows 8 - so this can happen a lot in Muri!

The game also uses Z and X keys, so we recommend using them on Windows 8, or use the ingame remapping to play however you like.

<3

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - MURI
notes.content:
MURI is Now Available on Steam!
MURI is a DOS-style shooter from Remar Games and Ludosity.

After the colonization of Mars, a team of scientists design an armor suit of cataclysmic power, sparking a conflict between several factions. When Mars suddenly vanishes, one woman sets out to discover the fate of humanity.

Inspired by the games of its time, MURI is an authentic '80s experience, with the focus often changing between run-and-gun action and more tactical combat.
